kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
استحثثت (form X)
# اِسْتَحْثَثْتُ (istaḥṯaṯtu) /is.taħ.θaθ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# اِسْتَحْثَثْتَ (istaḥṯaṯta) /is.taħ.θaθ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# اِسْتَحْثَثْتِ (istaḥṯaṯti) /is.taħ.θaθ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# اُسْتُحْثِثْتُ (ustuḥṯiṯtu) /us.tuħ.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
